'''Rod Latham Mind What You Have Learned''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls32.htm Mind What You Have Learned], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040306151755/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls32.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
